about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in Legends of War: Chronicles of Darkness, a medieval fantasy RTS that takes you to a world in constant war. Forge your empire from scratch, build your base, manage resources and command armies in epic real-time battles.

Explore a universe dominated by four powerful factions: Humans, Orcs, Dark Creatures and Forest Creatures. Each one offers its own combat style, unique units and strategies that will test your ability as a commander.

Enjoy a narrative campaign full of challenges and decisions that will mark the fate of the world, or face other players in online multiplayer and cooperative modes, where only the most cunning will survive.

With a 2.5D visual style that evokes the essence of the classics of the 90s and 2000s, Legends of War: Chronicles of Darkness combines the nostalgia of traditional RTS with a modern, deep and strategic experience.

Main features:

  • Construction of bases and territorial expansion.

  • Four unique factions with their own units and styles.

  • Resource management in the classic style.

  • Epic single player campaign.

  • Online and cooperative multiplayer.

  • 2.5D visual style with retro inspiration.
